name: Project Blaze V2
summary:
Project Blaze V2 is a spine-chilling VR horror experience where survival is never guaranteed. Trapped inside shifting, nightmarish levels, you must explore, solve, and escape before the darkness—or something far worse—catches you. Every corridor hides danger, every shadow conceals a threat, and every choice matters.
